The modern result closely reproduces the migrated archived optimum on all recorded headline metrics.
Because modern common-expression grouping remains in place, expression compression is not the cause of the failed default modern trajectory in this control.
Column ordering is a causal numerical compatibility variable for this severely conditioned NLP, not merely a correlation inferred from high-level determinism settings.
The explicit ordering remains a diagnostic and reproducibility control. A representation-robust scaling and initialization strategy is still preferable to relying on one historical permutation.
